title: Integral Side-Kerb Railway Platform Ramp
description: One original static railway platform approach module: a full-grounded continuous concrete-look body carries a broad inclined central lane, a short level upper landing and two integral full-thickness raised side kerbs. The high central surface is 0.77 m above the complete ground sole; the lower entrance retains a visible 0.04 m lip. All slope, landing, kerb tops, kerb inner walls, outside faces, end sections and underside are one closed connected shared-vertex editable mesh. Three constant opaque matte PBR tones, no texture. Native metres and Z up, uphill +Y, front -Y and horizontally centred ground origin. One whole modular model, zero scenes and no separately counted kerbs. Newly authored full material geometry; no old loading ramp, launch ramp, dropped curb, railway platform or track geometry is imported, shortened, rescaled, recoloured or renamed. No handrails, treads, anti-slip strips, platform, terrain, train, text, animation or alternative state. The nominal high surface height follows the railway theme; no mating, network, railway clearance or platform installation compatibility is asserted. Static illustrative visual geometry only: no accessibility, passenger use, wheelchair suitability, traction, real design gradient, navigation, collision, load, stability, drainage, manufacture, installation, engineering or safety certification.
